_doc: Slop n Roll Racing vehicles (docs/racing.md): loaded by the server (internal/game cars.go LoadCars) and the client (web/game/cars.js) and passed to the shared car sim (internal/sim car.go CarSpec: these keys are its fields' JS names). Speeds m/s, accelerations m/s², grips and drags per second, turn rates rad/s, sizes m [width, height, length], seat [x right, y up, z aft]. topSpeed rises strictly by tier, in small steps (TestCarTiers). front/rear: the built-in weapon and rear item (phase 3).

equipment.name: Linter Beam
equipment.desc: a laser along your heading: hitscan, light, many charges

equipment.name: Hotfix Missiles
equipment.desc: unguided rockets along your heading, splash

equipment.name: Rollback Rockets
equipment.desc: heavy rockets: slower, a bigger blast, fewer

equipment.name: Synergy Orbs
equipment.desc: slow energy orbs that home in on the nearest car ahead

equipment.name: Force-Push Ram Plate
equipment.desc: a plate on the nose: your rams hit twice as hard (no charges)

equipment.name: Breaking Changes
equipment.desc: spikes behind you: a car over them drifts out of control for a while

equipment.name: Spaghetti Code
equipment.desc: an oil slick: a car over it spins out

equipment.name: Tech Debt
equipment.desc: a mine: blows up under the next car, knocks it up

equipment.name: Scope Creep
equipment.desc: a sticky mine that creeps toward the nearest car

shop._doc: The race shop (internal/game carshop.go): a car of a tier (cars[].price), a front or rear item swapped in (swap), and upgrades by tier (prices of tiers 1, 2, 3; each bought in order): charges (+50% front and rear charges a lap per tier), tank (boost seconds a lap: base + tank per tier), plating (+25% car HP and ram damage per tier), engine (internal/sim CarEngineAccel/Top), tyres (CarTyreGrip/Turn; not for the hovercraft). Kept for the match.
